3._section_summary: This section reports a structural equation model tested in a single study (N = 249) examining links among caregiver eating messages, attachment, perfectionism, body appreciation, depressive symptoms, and intuitive eating. The original model fit was good (CFI = .98, SRMR = .04, RMSEA = .05); nonsignificant paths were trimmed, and one modification (attachment anxiety → order perfectionism) was added, yielding a final model with improved fit (CFI = .99, SRMR = .04, RMSEA = .03). The final model accounted for sizable variance in key outcomes (e.g., 40.5% of variance in body appreciation; 44.4% in intuitive eating).
